subject: pri-af-td
title: PRI.AF.TD.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 291 (CMOA(II)-49). PRI-AF-TD (primary affinity tendencies) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: A-PR (all-purpose) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From A-PR: ATTN (attraction). From SPT-DY: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and COS-D (cosmic dictates). From AF-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From COS-D: TR (transformation).
